units.id: mission:Deep Security Package Reveal|log|654|0
units.english: A young agent in the logistics division of Deep Security, he vouched for your increased job opportunities after you helped him out.
units.italian: Un giovane agente della divisione logistica della Deep Security: dopo che lo hai aiutato, ha garantito per te e ti ha aperto più opportunità di lavoro.

units.id: mission:Deep Security Package Reveal|As you turn to leave a food stand in the spaceport, a rather young man in activewear waves you over to a bench off to the side of the main drag.|656|0
units.english: As you turn to leave a food stand in the spaceport, a rather young man in activewear waves you over to a bench off to the side of the main drag.
units.italian: Mentre ti giri per lasciare un banco di cibo nello spazioporto, un uomo piuttosto giovane in abbigliamento sportivo ti fa cenno di avvicinarti a una panchina a lato della via principale.

units.id: mission:Deep Security Package Reveal|	(Go over to him.)|658|0
units.english: (Go over to him.)
units.italian: (Vai da lui.)

units.id: mission:Deep Security Package Reveal|	(Keep walking.)|660|0
units.english: (Keep walking.)
units.italian: (Continua a camminare.)

units.id: mission:Deep Security Package Reveal|	When you go to ignore him he gives a quick, sharp, whistle and briefly flashes a Deep Security badge at you. He immediately covers this with a friendly wave for any nearby eyes, but it is clear that he won't be ignored.|661|0
units.english: When you go to ignore him he gives a quick, sharp, whistle and briefly flashes a Deep Security badge at you. He immediately covers this with a friendly wave for any nearby eyes, but it is clear that he won't be ignored.
units.italian: Quando fai per ignorarlo, emette un fischio breve e acuto e ti mostra per un attimo un distintivo della Deep Security. Subito dopo copre il gesto con un saluto amichevole per eventuali occhi indiscreti, ma è chiaro che non si lascerà ignorare.

units.id: mission:Deep Security Package Reveal|	When you approach the bench he says, "Hello captain. Please, have a seat and allow me to take a moment of your time."|663|0
units.english: When you approach the bench he says, "Hello captain. Please, have a seat and allow me to take a moment of your time."
units.italian: Quando ti avvicini alla panchina dice: "Salve, capitano. Accomodati e concedimi un momento del tuo tempo."

units.id: mission:Deep Security Package Reveal|	His manner is very rehearsed, but he seems quite intent and assured in his request.|664|0
units.english: His manner is very rehearsed, but he seems quite intent and assured in his request.
units.italian: Il suo modo di fare è molto impostato, ma nella richiesta sembra deciso e sicuro.

units.id: mission:Deep Security Package Reveal|	"Sure. Who are you?"|666|0
units.english: "Sure. Who are you?"
units.italian: "Certo. Tu chi sei?"

units.id: mission:Deep Security Package Reveal|	"Sorry, but I'm busy right now."|668|0
units.english: "Sorry, but I'm busy right now."
units.italian: "Scusa, ma adesso sono impegnato."

units.id: mission:Deep Security Package Reveal|	"To be clear, I'm here to thank you, if that helps." he says.|669|0
units.english: "To be clear, I'm here to thank you, if that helps." he says.
units.italian: "Per essere chiari, sono qui per ringraziarti, se può servire" dice.

units.id: mission:Deep Security Package Reveal|	"Oh. What is it?" (Sit down.)|671|0
units.english: "Oh. What is it?" (Sit down.)
units.italian: "Oh. Di cosa si tratta?" (Siediti.)

units.id: mission:Deep Security Package Reveal|	"Sorry, maybe next time."|672|0
units.english: "Sorry, maybe next time."
units.italian: "Scusa, magari la prossima volta."

units.id: mission:Deep Security Package Reveal|	As you sit down, the man smiles at you before directing his attention back to those passing by as he speaks. "My name is Wayde, Agent Wayde if you will. Don't mind the title though, I... well I work in the logistics division for Deep Security. You've transported a large number of secure packages recently, and several of them were mine."|675|0
units.english: As you sit down, the man smiles at you before directing his attention back to those passing by as he speaks. "My name is Wayde, Agent Wayde if you will. Don't mind the title though, I... well I work in the logistics division for Deep Security. You've transported a large number of secure packages recently, and several of them were mine."
units.italian: Mentre ti siedi, l'uomo ti sorride e poi, parlando, riporta l'attenzione su chi passa. "Mi chiamo Wayde, l'agente Wayde se preferisci. Non badare al titolo, io... be', lavoro nella divisione logistica della Deep Security. Di recente hai trasportato un gran numero di pacchi sicuri, e alcuni erano miei."

units.id: mission:Deep Security Package Reveal|	"If it pays, it pays."|677|0
units.english: "If it pays, it pays."
units.italian: "Se paga, paga."

units.id: mission:Deep Security Package Reveal|	"Ah, yes."|679|0
units.english: "Ah, yes."
units.italian: "Ah, sì."

units.id: mission:Deep Security Package Reveal|	"Do all the secure packages belong to Deep Security?"|681|0
units.english: "Do all the secure packages belong to Deep Security?"
units.italian: "Tutti i pacchi sicuri appartengono alla Deep Security?"

units.id: mission:Deep Security Package Reveal|	"Oh no, plenty of tech businesses and wealthy individuals use the same secure package shipping channels. We do monitor all of them though just to make sure our own channels don't get compromised by something ill-advised... or illegal." He shrugs, giving you a measured look.|682|0
units.english: "Oh no, plenty of tech businesses and wealthy individuals use the same secure package shipping channels. We do monitor all of them though just to make sure our own channels don't get compromised by something ill-advised... or illegal." He shrugs, giving you a measured look.
units.italian: "Oh no, molte aziende tecnologiche e persone facoltose usano gli stessi canali di spedizione dei pacchi sicuri. Però li monitoriamo tutti, per essere sicuri che i nostri canali non vengano compromessi da qualcosa di imprudente... o di illegale." Scrolla le spalle e ti lancia uno sguardo misurato.
